meta.note: Values copied from the Tailwind config and classes of the Stitch HTML export. Light values are the export's non-dark classes, dark values its dark: classes. Tailwind v3 palette (slate, green, blue, purple) resolved to hex. Error, snackbar and inverse colors (danger*, inverse-*) were added on 2026-10-20 for error states; they are not in the Stitch export.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background (Stitch background-dark / background-light). Also the bottom bar fill.

tokens.name: bg-glass-80
tokens.usage: Sticky top bars, with a 12px backdrop blur (bg at 80%).

tokens.name: bg-glass-95
tokens.usage: Discover's sticky header with search and chips (bg at 95%).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and every card surface (15.7:1 dark, 16.7:1 light on bg).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Body text of beta notes, on note (10.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Long descriptions such as About this crag, on bg (6.7:1 dark, 7.1:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Locations, metadata, stat labels, route meta on bg and cards (6.1:1 dark on surface-card, 4.8:1 light on white).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Dates, GRADE captions, sport/trad captions. Light: 2.6:1 on white, below 4.5:1, kept as in Stitch.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Featured-route type and beta-note timestamps (slate-500). Dark: 3.3:1 on surface-row and note, below 4.5:1, kept as in Stitch.

tokens.name: ink-on-photo
tokens.usage: Hero title and topo labels over photos, always above the scrim or overlay.

tokens.name: ink-on-photo-muted
tokens.usage: Hero location line over the scrim.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand orange: filled CTAs, active nav item, grades, links, icon accents. As text: 7.9:1 on dark bg; on the light theme 2.0:1 on bg and 2.2:1 on white, below 4.5:1, kept as in Stitch.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (7.9:1). Stitch's route list uses white on primary in two places (2.2:1); this token replaces it in the system.

tokens.name: primary-5
tokens.usage: primary at 5%: crag card fill (dark), info tiles, stat tiles (dark).

tokens.name: primary-10
tokens.usage: primary at 10%: hairlines on bg, search fill (dark), hover of icon buttons, chips in the route list.

tokens.name: primary-20
tokens.usage: primary at 20%: tag fill, grade box, tile borders, unselected chip (dark).

tokens.name: primary-30
tokens.usage: primary at 30%: border of the PROJECT status tag.

tokens.name: primary-40
tokens.usage: primary at 40%: route card hover border.

tokens.name: primary-60
tokens.usage: primary at 60%: search icon in the route list.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Crag card fill.

tokens.name: surface-card-neutral
tokens.usage: Route list items and logbook entries.

tokens.name: surface-row
tokens.usage: Featured route rows on crag details.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Crag card border.

tokens.name: line-divider
tokens.usage: Divider inside a crag card, above its stats.

tokens.name: line-neutral
tokens.usage: Logbook entry border and thumbnail border.

tokens.name: line-neutral-divider
tokens.usage: Divider inside a logbook entry.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Unselected filter chip fill on Discover.

tokens.name: chip-ink
tokens.usage: Unselected filter chip label, on chip (5.4:1 dark, 8.4:1 light).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Search field fill on Discover.

tokens.name: field-icon
tokens.usage: Search icon in the Discover field.

tokens.name: field-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder in the Discover search. 2.3:1 dark, 2.2:1 light on field, below 4.5:1, kept as in Stitch.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Beta note card fill (slate-800 at 50% / slate-100).

tokens.name: note-line
tokens.usage: Beta note card border.

tokens.name: button-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill (Save List); its label is ink.

tokens.name: nav-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive bottom bar items. 2.4:1 on bg in both themes, below 3:1, kept as in Stitch's Discover screen.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: SENT and FLASH tags, text on success-soft. Light: 3.3:1, below 4.5:1, kept as in Stitch.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of SENT and FLASH tags.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Border of the SENT tag.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: REDPOINT tag text, on info-soft (5.3:1 dark, 4.6:1 light).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the REDPOINT tag.

tokens.name: special
tokens.usage: ONSIGHT tag text, on special-soft (5.1:1 dark, 4.8:1 light).

tokens.name: special-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the ONSIGHT tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: error icons and error text on bg, cards and danger-soft (6.2:1 dark, 6.0:1 light on bg). Not from Stitch: added for error states.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger icons and of error banners.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of error banners.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar fill: the opposite of the screen (same values as ink).

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Snackbar text on inverse-surface (15.7:1 dark, 16.7:1 light).

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Snackbar action label on inverse-surface (5.0:1 dark, 8.2:1 light).

tokens.name: inverse-success
tokens.usage: Success icon in a snackbar, on inverse-surface (4.6:1 dark, 10.3:1 light).

tokens.name: inverse-danger
tokens.usage: Error icon in a snackbar, on inverse-surface (5.9:1 dark, 6.5:1 light).

tokens.name: inverse-info
tokens.usage: Offline and info icons in a snackbar, on inverse-surface (4.7:1 dark, 7.0:1 light).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the crag hero gradient (to top: scrim, transparent at 50%).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Topo View badge backdrop over a photo, with a 4px blur.

tokens.name: overlay-strong
tokens.usage: Crux label pill on the topo.

tokens.name: overlay-line
tokens.usage: Border of the Topo View badge.

styles.name: input

styles.name: chip

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale, only the steps the screens use.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label in the bottom bar and in location lines.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of micro tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and tags; gap between top bar actions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, tiles and list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding, card padding in lists, top bar padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Crag card body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between crag cards and between sections; hero text padding; FAB right offset.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bottom spacer before the bottom bar on Discover.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: FAB distance from the bottom edge (clears the bottom bar).

radius.note: Stitch overrides Tailwind's radii: rounded = 8px, rounded-lg = 16px, rounded-xl = 24px. Most surfaces are 24px.

tokens.name: radius

tokens.usage: Route list chips, the grade box, logbook thumbnails, the Topo View badge, the square FAB on crag details.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, search fields, Discover chips, buttons, the logbook FAB.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, round FAB, style pills, avatars.
